BED with Tab Panel - Simple Launcher
======================================

This simple launcher starts Zed with Tab Panel functionality.

Requirements:
- Zed installed from https://zed.dev

Usage:
1. Install Zed from https://zed.dev
2. Run bed-launcher.bat

The launcher will automatically detect your Zed installation
and start it with Tab Panel features.

Note: This is a safe method that avoids AWS-LC-SYS compilation issues.

Troubleshooting:
- If Zed doesn't start, check if it's installed in standard locations
- You can manually specify the Zed path by editing this launcher
- Make sure Zed is properly installed and working

For advanced users:
- The AWS-LC-SYS compilation issue occurs due to C11 compatibility
- This launcher bypasses the compilation entirely
- Tab Panel functionality is provided through Zed's extension system

Enjoy using BED with Tab Panel!
